questions.question: Two viral isolates both have RNA genomes, but one genome is single-stranded and the other is double-stranded. Which feature distinguishes them in this classification?
options: The number of strands in the genome
The temperature of the host organism
The number of cells in the host tissue
The location where the sample was collected
questions.explanation: Viral genomes can be distinguished by whether they are single-stranded or double-stranded.
questions.subject: biology

questions.question: A lake warms more slowly than nearby dry ground on a sunny afternoon. Which property of water best explains this difference?
options: Its ability to form ionic bonds with soil
Its low density in the liquid state
Its rapid evaporation at all temperatures
questions.explanation: Water can absorb substantial heat before its temperature changes appreciably because it has a high specific heat capacity.
questions.subject: biology

questions.question: A model shows two DNA strands winding around a shared axis. Which description best names this arrangement?
questions.explanation: The Watson–Crick model describes DNA as two strands arranged in a double-helical structure.
questions.subject: biology

questions.question: A cell's DNA is enclosed by a membrane-bound nucleus. Which broad cell category does this observation support?
questions.explanation: Eukaryotic cells have DNA enclosed in a membrane-bound nucleus; prokaryotic cells do not.
questions.subject: biology

questions.question: An experiment changes temperature while keeping pH and enzyme amount constant. Which factor is being tested for its effect on enzyme action?
questions.explanation: Because temperature is the variable changed while the other stated conditions are controlled, the experiment tests temperature's effect on enzyme action.
questions.subject: biology
